question_en: All blue folders are archived. Folder X is blue. Is Folder X archived?
answer_en: Yes. Since every blue folder is archived and Folder X is blue, Folder X is archived.

question_en: No wooden container is transparent. Container Y is wooden. Can Container Y be transparent?
answer_en: No. Since no wooden container is transparent, Container Y cannot be transparent.

question_en: Maya is taller than Liam, and Liam is taller than Noah. Who is shortest?
answer_en: Noah is shortest because Maya is taller than Liam and Liam is taller than Noah.

question_en: A shelf holds 46 books. Twelve are removed and 7 are added. How many books remain?
answer_en: 46 - 12 = 34, then 34 + 7 = 41. There are 41 books on the shelf.

question_en: Emma arrived before Daniel, and Daniel arrived before Sarah. Who arrived last?
answer_en: Sarah arrived last. The order is Emma, Daniel, then Sarah.

question_en: A user may access the portal only if both identity verification and account activation are complete. Identity is verified, but the account is inactive. Is access allowed?
answer_en: No. Both conditions are required, and the account is not active, so access is not allowed.

question_en: A laptop costs 240 dollars and receives a 20 percent discount. What is the new price?
answer_en: Twenty percent of 240 is 48. Subtracting 48 from 240 gives a new price of 192 dollars.

question_en: Olivia scored 84 points and Ethan scored 67. How many more points did Olivia score?
answer_en: 84 - 67 = 17, so Olivia scored 17 more points.

question_en: A team has 18 senior members and 12 junior members. What is the ratio of senior to junior members in simplest form?
answer_en: The ratio is 18:12. Dividing both numbers by 6 gives 3:2.

question_en: There are 8 boxes with 6 items in each box. Fifteen items are then removed. How many items remain?
answer_en: There are initially 8 × 6 = 48 items. After removing 15, 48 - 15 = 33 items remain.

question_en: If the access token is valid, the request is accepted. The request was not accepted. Can we conclude that the token was not valid?
answer_en: Yes. Under the stated rule, a valid token would make the request accepted. Since it was not accepted, the token was not valid.

question_en: If the battery is empty, the device shuts down. The device has shut down. Does this prove that the battery is empty?
answer_en: No. The device could have shut down for another reason; the statement does not say an empty battery is the only possible cause.

question_en: All engineers are employees. Some employees are managers. Can we conclude that some engineers are managers?
answer_en: No. The managers among the employees are not necessarily engineers.

question_en: All roses are plants. No plant is a machine. Can a rose be a machine?
answer_en: No. A rose is a plant, and no plant is a machine, so a rose cannot be a machine.

question_en: A train travels 360 kilometers in 6 hours at a constant speed. How far does it travel in one hour?
answer_en: 360 ÷ 6 = 60. The train travels 60 kilometers in one hour.

question_en: Four test scores are 64, 72, 80, and 92. What is the average?
answer_en: 64 + 72 + 80 + 92 = 308. Dividing by 4 gives an average of 77.

question_en: A workshop begins at 09:35 and lasts 2 hours 15 minutes. When does it finish?
answer_en: Adding 2 hours 15 minutes to 09:35 gives 11:50. The workshop ends at 11:50.

question_en: What is the next number in the sequence 4, 8, 16, 32, ?
answer_en: Each number is twice the previous one. 32 × 2 = 64, so the next number is 64.

question_en: What is the next number in the sequence 45, 39, 33, 27, ?
answer_en: The sequence decreases by 6 each time. 27 - 6 = 21, so the next number is 21.

question_en: Five notebooks cost 35 dollars at the same unit price. How much do 8 notebooks cost?
answer_en: One notebook costs 35 ÷ 5 = 7 dollars. Eight notebooks cost 8 × 7 = 56 dollars.

question_en: Point A is east of Point B, and Point C is east of Point A. Which point is farthest west?
answer_en: Point B is farthest west because A is east of B and C is east of A.

question_en: In a race, Laura finished before James, and James finished before David. Who finished second?
answer_en: James finished second. The order is Laura, James, David.

question_en: A machine produces 11 components per hour. At the same rate, how many components does it produce in 7 hours?
answer_en: 11 × 7 = 77. The machine produces 77 components in 7 hours.

question_en: A tank contains 130 liters of water. Forty-eight liters are used and 21 liters are added. How much water is in the tank now?
answer_en: 130 - 48 = 82, then 82 + 21 = 103. The tank now contains 103 liters.

question_en: Every object in Group A is also in Group B. No object in Group B belongs to Group C. Can an object in Group A belong to Group C?
answer_en: No. Every Group A object is in Group B, and no Group B object is in Group C, so a Group A object cannot belong to Group C.

question_en: All encrypted files require a password. File Z is encrypted. Does File Z require a password?
answer_en: Yes. Since every encrypted file requires a password and File Z is encrypted, File Z requires a password.

question_en: No paper container is waterproof. Container Q is made of paper. Can Container Q be waterproof?
answer_en: No. Since no paper container is waterproof, Container Q cannot be waterproof.

question_en: Sophia is older than Mia, and Mia is older than Chloe. Who is youngest?
answer_en: Chloe is youngest because Sophia is older than Mia and Mia is older than Chloe.

question_en: A warehouse contains 58 packages. Nineteen are removed and 8 are added. How many packages remain?
answer_en: 58 - 19 = 39, then 39 + 8 = 47. There are 47 packages remaining.

question_en: Noah arrived after Ethan, and Ethan arrived after Grace. Who arrived first?
answer_en: Grace arrived first. The order is Grace, Ethan, then Noah.

question_en: A report can be submitted only if both manager approval and a digital signature are present. Approval is present, but the signature is missing. Can the report be submitted?
answer_en: No. Both requirements must be satisfied, and the missing digital signature prevents submission.

question_en: A product price rises from 250 dollars to 275 dollars. What percentage increase is this?
answer_en: The increase is 25 dollars. 25 ÷ 250 = 0.10, so the price increased by 10 percent.

question_en: Henry has 96 points and Lucas has 74. What is the difference between their scores?
answer_en: 96 - 74 = 22. The difference between their scores is 22 points.

question_en: A garden contains 28 apple trees and 42 pear trees. What is the ratio of apple trees to all trees in simplest form?
answer_en: There are 28 + 42 = 70 trees in total. The ratio is 28:70, which simplifies to 2:5.

question_en: A store has 9 boxes with 7 bottles in each. Twenty bottles are sold. How many bottles remain?
answer_en: There are initially 9 × 7 = 63 bottles. After selling 20, 63 - 20 = 43 bottles remain.

question_en: If the security check passes, the green indicator turns on. The green indicator is off. Can we conclude that the security check did not pass?
answer_en: Yes. Under the stated rule, passing the security check would turn on the green indicator. Since it is off, the check did not pass.

question_en: If the server overheats, the service stops. The service has stopped. Does this prove that the server overheated?
answer_en: No. The service could have stopped for another reason, so the observation does not prove that overheating occurred.

question_en: Some researchers are lecturers. All lecturers are university employees. Can we conclude that some researchers are university employees?
answer_en: Yes. The researchers who are lecturers are also university employees because every lecturer is a university employee.

question_en: All whales are animals. No animal is a building. Can a whale be a building?
answer_en: No. A whale is an animal, and no animal is a building, so a whale cannot be a building.

question_en: A car travels 280 kilometers in 4 hours at a constant speed. How far will it travel in the next 3 hours at the same speed?
answer_en: Its speed is 280 ÷ 4 = 70 kilometers per hour. In 3 hours it will travel 70 × 3 = 210 kilometers.

question_en: The average of four measurements is 36. The first three are 28, 34, and 40. What is the fourth measurement?
answer_en: The total must be 36 × 4 = 144. The first three total 102, so the fourth measurement is 144 - 102 = 42.

question_en: A meeting began at 13:40 and ended at 16:05. How long did it last?
answer_en: From 13:40 to 16:05 is 2 hours 25 minutes. The meeting lasted 2 hours 25 minutes.

question_en: What is the next number in the sequence 3, 9, 27, 81, ?
answer_en: Each number is three times the previous one. 81 × 3 = 243, so the next number is 243.

question_en: What is the next number in the sequence 100, 88, 76, 64, ?
answer_en: The sequence decreases by 12 each time. 64 - 12 = 52, so the next number is 52.

question_en: Seven kilograms of rice cost 56 dollars at a constant unit price. How much do 11 kilograms cost?
answer_en: One kilogram costs 56 ÷ 7 = 8 dollars. Eleven kilograms cost 11 × 8 = 88 dollars.

question_en: Point P is north of Point Q. Point R is east of Point P. In which direction is Point R relative to Point Q?
answer_en: Point R is both north and east of Point Q, so it is northeast of Point Q.

question_en: In a race, Chloe finished before Mia, and Mia finished before Ava. Who finished last?
answer_en: Ava finished last. The order is Chloe, Mia, Ava.

question_en: A processor handles 16 tasks per minute. At the same rate, how many tasks does it handle in 9 minutes?
answer_en: 16 × 9 = 144. The processor handles 144 tasks in 9 minutes.

question_en: A storage tank contains 180 liters. Sixty-five liters are used and 24 liters are added. How much remains?
answer_en: 180 - 65 = 115, then 115 + 24 = 139. The tank contains 139 liters.

question_en: Every item in Set X belongs to Set Y. No item in Set Y belongs to Set Z. Can an item in Set X belong to Set Z?
answer_en: No. Every Set X item is in Set Y, and no Set Y item is in Set Z, so a Set X item cannot belong to Set Z.
